title: SatQKD-Sentinel: simulation, telemetry analytics and geostationary-backbone toolkit for satellite QKD networks with optical phased arrays
description: Software accompanying the article AI-Driven Telemetry Analytics for Cybersecurity of Satellite Quantum Key Distribution Networks with a Geostationary Backbone and Optical Phased Arrays. This release contains the complete simulation and analytics pipeline: deterministic link and key-rate model (Equations (1)-(9)), finite-key analysis (Equation (10)), optical phased array model (Equations (12)-(16)), trusted-relay network model (Equations (17)-(22)), geostationary-backbone analysis (Equations (28)-(32)), telemetry simulator for 10 link states (Table 3), 24 physics-informed feature extraction (Equations (25)-(26)), multi-class classifiers (gradient boosting, random forest, logistic regression) and novelty detectors (isolation forest, Mahalanobis), evaluation framework with alarm logic and block policies. Includes a comprehensive Jupyter notebook demonstrating all calculations, visualisations and conclusions. All results are model estimates; no experimental data are included.
